text: Rosenthal's view that a mental state becomes conscious in virtue of being the object of a suitable thought about that very state is called the ___ thought theory of consciousness.
explanation: Higher-order thought (HOT) theory holds that a first-order state is conscious because it is represented by a suitable higher-order thought about it; states lacking such a representation remain unconscious. The expected phrase is 'higher-order,' and Rosenthal is its best-known defender.
